notes: Standalone archived primitive executables, not the current production DSOs or all historical split32 programs.
Seven small cases per parameter: raw permutation, SHAKE, uniform, eta at 17/65 requests, ExpandMask and SampleInBall; three comparison backends are retained.
No source edits, no compilation and no performance claim. A pass only covers the selected inputs and binary hashes.
150-second execution budget across three processes; each owned instrumented child is limited to 45 seconds or remaining budget. Export/SSH transfer are additional.
Only the child process group created by this runner may be stopped at timeout; no other GPU process is stopped.
Privately rebuilt standalone primitive executables, not production DSOs or all historical split32 programs. Historical performance timings are not transferred to the patched binaries.
Seven small cases per parameter: raw permutation, SHAKE, uniform, eta at 17/65 requests, ExpandMask and SampleInBall; three comparison backends are retained.
Two shared-stream barriers are inserted in a private standalone harness; each parameter is rebuilt with the original flags and checked with racecheck/memcheck/synccheck. No performance claim.
150-second execution budget across private builds and nine tool processes; each owned instrumented child is limited to 30 seconds or remaining budget. Export/SSH transfer are additional.
Only the child process group created by this runner may be stopped at timeout; no other GPU process is stopped.
Three CUDA API failure-return probes per parameter: workspace initialization, host-to-device input staging, and device-to-host output export.
Unchanged production Sign DSOs; a new host caller and a process-local LD_PRELOAD interposer are test artifacts, not formal performance binaries.
Each parameter uses the same loaded DSO, stream and workspace for success/fault/recovery across seven calls. No manual workspace clearing occurs between calls.
Failure must propagate backend_error, mark all requests failed, commit none, and preserve sentinel host output. Valid/recovery bytes match the retained selected official vector.
Residual workspace bytes are counted after failures; residual nonzero bytes do not establish secret content but prevent claiming complete automatic zeroization.
These are injected CUDA function return codes, not actual device memory exhaustion, asynchronous device faults, sampler exhaustion, or every internal error path.
No sampler total hard cap or explicit exhaustion status was added by the incremental refill patch. This group remains partial until the missing paths/contracts are addressed.
Three selected official Sign vectors repeated to B256; no new independent KAT coverage, performance claim or sanitizer claim.
150-second admission/execution target including host compilation and shared-lock waits. Packaging, upload, download and user passphrase time are additional.

experiments.notes: 3次快照同一9行矩阵，非3组实验；本包未携带当前工具/KAT所引用全部结果包；当前资格范围为审计声明。
